news.headline: Trump Is Pushing Ukraine to Surrender to Russia, Zelensky Says
news.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said he didn’t want to believe that Washington wanted an end to the war at Ukraine’s expense. “But that’s how it looks,” he added.
